review_methodology: Q8 (lidar-state-estimation-plan.md Section 21): do replacement jump candidates represent the same phenomenon? Answer: no. Candidates partition cleanly at max_lateral_residual_m=5.0: nothing falls between 3.50m and 6.52m in the actual distribution. Above the threshold (n=27) is a temporally-clustered (80s window) association/gating defect verified by direct trajectory inspection, distinct from genuine jump candidates and excluded here. Below it (n=2109) is consistent with the intended phenomenon and spans nearly the full multi-month capture history, as a jump-candidate population should. The frozen regression set is the top 33 of that population by severity, matching the scale of the unavailable historical 33-track set; the remainder is retained as a deferred pool, not discarded.
